content: On May 26, 2022, a correction was made to the WHO recommendations on maternal and newborn care aimed at promoting a positive postnatal experience. Specifically, on page 93, line 3 of the web supplement's evidence base (ISBN 978-92-4-004617-7, electronic version), the following change was implemented: The original reference, Source: Turawa EB, Musekiwa A, Rohwer AC. Interventions for preventing postpartum constipation. 2015; (9): CD011625, was deleted. It was replaced with the updated reference, Source: Turawa EB, Musekiwa A, Rohwer AC. Interventions for preventing postpartum constipation. 2020; (8): CD011625. This correction has been incorporated into the electronic version of the document.
